title: Fast 60-hour time-series momentum, flat within the day

source.title: Time Series Momentum (Moskowitz, Ooi, Pedersen), via lab hypothesis H-016

rule_summary: Chart 1h, closed bars only, signal at bar close, fill at next open. ENTRY: close(t)/close(t-60) > 1 AND close(t) > close(t-1) AND no open position AND 2 bars passed since the last exit. EXIT at bar close when close(t)/close(t-60) <= 1. STOP: fixed 2% below entry (native). No take-profit, no regime filter. DAY-TRADE FRAME (same for every fast variant): entries only on bars opening 00:00-16:00 UTC, at most 2 entries per pair per UTC day; any open position is sold at the open of the 23:00 UTC bar or 12 hourly bars after entry, whichever comes first (never held overnight). Long only, spot, one position per pair, no pyramiding.
mechanism: Time-series momentum with the 30-day lookback of the parent compressed by 12 (2.5 days = 60 hourly bars); the sign of recent return predicts the next hours. The close above previous close condition keeps entries on rising bars. Fast variant of a tried rule: the parent holds days or weeks; this one is forced flat within the day so the dry-run reaches 60 trades in weeks. Costs (0.30% round trip) are NOT relaxed.
